title: koreader.json
description: KOReader progress-sync configuration, written by KOReaderCredentialStore (lib/KOReaderSync/KOReaderCredentialStore.cpp) to /.crosspoint/koreader.json.

cfgVersion.description: Config format version; absent means 1. On loading a version below 2 with credentials and an empty serverUrl, serverUrl is pinned to the old default https://sync.koreader.rocks:443.

password_obf.description: Password XORed with a key derived from the device MAC address, then base64-encoded. Only decodable on the device that wrote it.

password.description: Legacy plaintext password, read only when password_obf is absent or undecodable.

serverUrl.description: Custom sync server URL. Empty uses https://sync.crosspointreader.com; a value without a scheme gets http:// prepended.

matchMethod.description: How documents are matched on the server: 0 = filename, 1 = partial MD5 of file content. Out-of-range values load as 0.

sendMetadata.description: Send document metadata along with progress.

syncBehavior.description: How manual sync resolves differences: 0 = ask every time, 1 = smart (auto-resolve using furthest progress). Absent or out-of-range values load as 0.
